test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A robber steals a bag from a man at 5 p.m. and starts running at 10 km/h. A policeman is informed about the robber at 5 : 12 p.m. and he chases him on a cycle at 15 km/h. At what time is the robber caught by the policeman?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the robber = 10 km/h

Speed of the policeman = 15 km/h

Time when the robber starts running = 5:00 p.m.

Time when the policeman starts chasing = 5:12 p.m.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Time difference between the robber and the policeman = 12 minutes = 12/60
